name: Kano City (KSA-1 master plan): A2 gateway, ring road, middle and wall rings, radial arterials, districts D05, D06, D08, D09, D10, D11 and the mixed urban quarters

meta.gameCoverage: KANO CITY. The actual city on the master plan's 10 x 10 km frame (KSA-1, docs/KANO_CITY_MASTER_PLAN.md): the A2 into the ring road through the D11 gateway and the D10 industrial roads, the ring road with its roundabouts, the middle ring and the road along the old city wall, the radial arterials, the districts D05 (commercial belt), D06 (modern residential estate), D08 (institutional corridor) and D09 (transport hub, bus terminal), and the plan's mixed urban quarters (F-MID) with their own streets everywhere between the wall and the ring road. Not built yet: inside the wall (the old city, Kurmi market and the landmarks wait for proper references) and the D07 traditional suburb (blocked on references). Positions are the plan's (indicative, not survey).
meta.notes: The Kano city route (owner directive 2026-11-16). docs/KANO_CITY.md.
